decision_rationale: The record describes a new model, Celler, and a large-scale pretraining setup on 40 million cells, so it has foundation-model-like breadth. The generation claim is weaker because the method evidence is masked-value prediction with a multilayer perceptron rather than an explicit decoder or autoregressive generator.
